---

**How membership works.** A program appears here only when the vendor's own page
affirmatively establishes it. An unknown value is never treated as permission, so
this list is a floor, not a ceiling — some excluded programs may also qualify,
but we have not confirmed it. See the
[verification policy](../docs/verification-policy.md).
